Our client based in the South Burnett Region located 2 hours from the Sunshine coast  are seeking a motivated and experienced General Practitioner to join their dynamic team of healthcare professionals. They offer a supportive and collaborative work environment with a range of benefits to help our GPs achieve their professional goals. 

 Key Benefits: 

 
	 Relocation assistance provided 
	 On-site nursing, pathology, and range of allied health services 
	 Full clinical autonomy 
	 On and off-site operational and clinical management support 
	 Comprehensive clinical protocols and internal supply network for PPE and other equipment 
	 Flexible work arrangements with optional telehealth 
	 Opportunities for GPs working towards their Fellowship in FSP, ACRRM, or RVTS (MMM4 clasification) 
	 DPA eligibility for GPs restricted by moratorium. 
 

 This client values their GPs' personal and professional development, and they strive to provide them with the resources and support they need to succeed. If you are a passionate and dedicated GP looking for a supportive and dynamic work environment, we would love to hear from you. 

   

  Essential Criteria  

 
	 Strong verbal and written communication skills 
	 Vocational Registration (FRACGP | FACRRM | FRNZCGP) 
	 Full Australian Work Rights 
	 General Practice experience in Australia 
	 Passion and commitment to providing a high level of care to patients

result.description:
A modern, purpose-built medical centre in the beautiful coastal community of Port Stephens is seeking a  General Practitioner . This  DPA and MMM4 approved  location is suitable for both  VR and non-VR GPs , including international medical graduates and those subject to moratorium requirements.  Locum opportunities are also available . 

 The centre is a mixed-billing practice with consistently high patient demand, caring for a mix of self-funded retirees and a growing number of young families. The health hub features 12 consultation rooms, a three-bed treatment facility, and two procedure rooms. There is also a satellite site in a nearby community, where doctors have the flexibility to split their time. The practice is supported by a strong team of ten experienced nurses across both locations, who provide full Chronic Disease Management (CDM) support, assist with skin procedures, and conduct in-home health assessments for elderly patients. A large administrative team of 13 staff ensures efficient day-to-day operations. On-site allied health services include a pharmacy, radiology, pathology, and a speech pathologist. 

 Practitioners benefit from strong collaboration and ongoing clinical support, with a welcoming culture that includes regular team meetings and team-building activities. The practice is a registrar training facility with supervisor opportunities available. Doctors are offered clinical autonomy as independent contractors with flexible working arrangements. The practice supports professional growth, including CPD through a partnership with the RACGP, free in-house opportunities, and discounted registration for industry events. Support is also available for practitioners with special interests, including opportunities in skin, aesthetics, and occupational medicine. The centre is backed by a major healthcare division, providing sophisticated IT, marketing, and finance services with 24-hour IT support. 

 Located in a beautiful coastal community, the area offers a superb lifestyle with stunning beaches and waterways, providing an excellent work-life balance.   Apply Now
